Gnani AI Launches Sovereign AI Stack 'Artha'

Gnani AI has launched its 'Artha' sovereign AI stack, featuring the 30-billion-parameter Evon 3.3 model. The launch event was attended by Vice-President Radhakrishnan, who stated that new technologies like AI will enhance ease of work and create more jobs. The Artha stack is designed for Indian enterprises and public institutions.
